title: The Survey Team
text: "Femi Bede. I'm the one who looks at hulls. I'm sorry about the hour, and the wind, and that we can't fight. We'll walk; you keep the things with teeth off us. It seems a fair trade to me. It may not to you."

choices.label: Lead on
choices.reply: The three of them shoulder their packs and set off north-east, into the dunes, without waiting to see whether you follow.

notes: survey-set-out brings in the survey-team encounter (allied Kindred engineers walking camp → hull → camp).
